## AUD-2145 — Written instantiation arguments lose source bindings (open)

The unchanged compiler invents a defaulted second written argument for an explicit
`<char>` instantiation. Native declaration-name parsing now supplies typed source
arguments before REX construction, replacing semantic-to-written substitution,
comma counting and duplicate parser setup. Clang owns the replayed token buffer.
Exact token indexing includes split closers and unwraps their native split-location
provenance. The existing contract covers omitted defaults, `(1 + 1)`, members,
nested arguments, macros and escaped newlines. Lexical lookup supplies arguments
and leading return types; parameter types retain their declarator context.

This batch is **not resolved**. An independent stock-Clang-accepted input declares
a namespace alias after an explicit instantiation. EOF replay sees that later
alias: JSON records a written `char` argument and complete semantic `long` argument,
despite process and checkpoint exits of zero. The existing production contract now
asserts exact argument type identity and fails at that assertion (CTest exit8).
Capture original point-of-declaration bindings through a sound frontend interface;
do not repair the wrong argument from the semantic list or waive the discrepancy.
A temporary token observer exposed no annotations for this input and was removed.

LLVM22.1.8's [explicit-instantiation producer](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/llvmorg-22.1.8/clang/lib/Sema/SemaTemplate.cpp)
discards the original declarator; its
[instantiation-request listener](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/llvmorg-22.1.8/clang/lib/AST/Decl.cpp)

## AUD-2089 — Respect typed constructor initializer roles in ICG

The existing ICG specimen gains a delegating constructor; the driver requires
delegation to remain the sole initializer. Stock Clang accepts the source. The
unchanged implementation fails that assertion: recursive class-type scanning
misses delegation and adds direct base initialization.

Read direct initializer roles instead, excluding members and retaining distinct
virtual/nonvirtual base identities. Follow typed aliases to canonical classes;
unknown roles and duplicate base identities still fail hard. Delete the recursive
scanner: 45 production lines added, 87 removed; existing tests gain 14 lines.
No frontend data model, schema, script or suppression changes.

The first fix rejects an alias-wrapped base type; the final typed query handles
that valid case. Both builds pass. On the final source, icg_1 passes and icg_2
passes the delegation assertion before failing statement-output-owner during
unparsing. The exact pre-batch source also fails there. Isolating default-function
generation reproduces the failure without the other ICG transforms. Its hidden
lexical destructor calls still require a typed epilogue; this is not an ICG pass.

Evidence: source-icg-typed-targets-aliases-20261015.sha256 (21,341 inputs),
container-icg-{delegation,typed-targets,pre-batch-comparison,base-cleanup-isolation}-*
logs, two binary and 234 registry hashes. Restored fixed binaries match the tested
binaries exactly. Formatting/diff checks pass. No memory or full gates ran.

## Validation evidence

Local evidence is under ignored `build-audit/baseline/`. The initial host suite
started before source changes; it is incomplete coverage because Valgrind-backed
uninitialized-field tests are disabled. Complete baseline builds use the archived
source and exact recursive submodule revisions, independent of subsequent edits.

The initial host run completed: **31,733/31,733 passed** in 1,682.72 seconds.
Its disabled uninitialized-field configuration remains a limitation. Expanded
baseline registries contain 37,387 regular/sanitizer tests and 37,450 Memcheck
tests. The expanded regular baseline completed **37,387/37,387 passing** in
4,236.57 seconds. The initial cleanup candidate completed **37,391/37,391
passing** in 4,045.44 seconds; execution-name coverage checks pass for both.
That candidate preserves all old
regular names, labels, expectations, dependencies, fixtures, and timeouts, and
adds four passing audit/CMake/statement-numbering contracts.

The later unmasked and semantic snapshots have separate build directories and
logs. Earlier candidate results do not establish acceptance for these changes.
External evidence and proposed exceptions are recorded separately; unresolved
reports keep the memory gates failing.

The full sanitizer baseline completed 36,046 eligible tests with 113 failures:
103 OpenMP test failures, five slicing use-after-free reports, and five macro
metadata leak reports. The OpenMP runtime reproducer is recorded in the external
register; individual runtime-test diagnostics remain part of the review.
The two REX lifetime fixes passed a 24-test ASan/LSan/UBSan focused run, including
the original individual failing slicing/macro cases. The new graph cleanup and
shared macro lifetime tests pass in the regular build. The earlier template
snapshot passed six focused contracts and 58 related template regressions.

string-recovery removals, Flang reproducer/exception, and the CMake version change.

contains the three grouping corrections and AUD-015 slicing cleanup. Complete

The checked snapshot passed a 17-test focused run (including the original
AUD-016 assertion cases). Full Debug and Release runs both exposed AUD-017.

AUD-037's baseline debugger trace is retained in
`build-audit/copy-cache-baseline-trace/`. The same copied SgTypedefType has its
canonical pointer entry deleted repeatedly by the existing-copy branch of the
type materializer. The later assertion observes two distinct SgPointerType
objects with the exact same base pointer. The baseline exits 134 with zero
Valgrind errors or lost bytes. This is a REX semantic identity defect, not a
Valgrind report exception. The frozen typed8 snapshot contains the construction
fix and its new contract; its validation is separate from the passing isolated
nightly patch and the earlier typed7 suites.

registries preserve every previous test contract and add the cache test.
Full regular and broader instrumented validation remain in progress.

timeout. Evidence is in `build-audit/wrapper-report-validation{,-final}/`.

acceptance. Keep the original diagnostics and rerun affected validation with
the corrected collector; do not weaken the report completeness check.

with a FIFO and a single reader writing CTest's continuous report. Reopening
the FIFO cannot truncate earlier bytes. Immediate error markers still determine
failure before an excluded exec that omits its final summary. The contract now
also checks instrumented exec with the same PID, a child's error between fork
and exec, eight simultaneous failing children, and ordinary command failure.
Earlier process-part aggregation evidence is retained but does not establish
complete report preservation. Final stream evidence is under
`build-audit/wrapper-report-validation-stream/`.

## AUD-1257 — Clang initializer count carries undefined metadata

The stock first-error diagnostic 94598 exits 99. Shadow registers show the
count value 2 has undefined mask `0xffffffff`; the initializer storage and
pointer registers are fully defined. In a later helper invocation, the member
counter is 2 and fully defined before flexible-array extraction. The record's
packed metadata has undefined bits 22/23; the installed getter extracts bit 23.
Single-step output does not establish reliable subsequent shadow propagation.
The [LLVM 22.1.8 constructor](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/llvmorg-22.1.8/clang/lib/AST/Decl.cpp#L4798)
explicitly initializes that flag to false, so its later write history still
needed tracing at this stage. AUD-1260 subsequently establishes that write
and count chain for the first dependence report; remaining contexts stay open.

The installed library's constructor instruction at ELF address `0x1901f7b`

signature expands it into zero or multiple parameters. CTest43540 reproduces

production line changes. Native fold-pack CTest56376 passes; its JSON
checkpoint passes after AUD-1347 corrects the reader's ownership contract.

The root fix is partial and unbuilt. SgPntrArrRefExp now has optional typed

character-literal substrings now measure their typed TypeAndShape through the
target folding context and pass storage size during construction. Call-parsed
array references use the semantic result type, preserving section rank instead

General substring construction still uses the parent's CHARACTER type. Its
inquiry path separately ignores the integer-valued LEN/KIND operation. LLVM22
represents these inquiries as intrinsic calls with typed substring arguments;
propagating the whole integer result as a substring type would be incorrect.

result, so reanalyzing the mutated designator can lose the intrinsic operation.

accepted. See [LLVM22 expression analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/llvm/llvm-project/release/22.x/flang/lib/Semantics/expression.cpp).
